result.title: ContextRenderer: Dynamic-Context Video Generation for Interactive Game Worlds
result.summary: Interactive game world models separate executable world evolution from visual generation, using video models to render engine-provided scene representations into detailed observations. During sustained gameplay, however, existing generative renderers struggle to follow changing conditions while preserving visual continuity across diverse proxies and target styles. We therefore introduce ContextRenderer, an autoregressive video diffusion framework designed for both dynamic conditioning and cross-proxy generalization. It couples Dynamic-Context Learning (DCL) for chunk-level interaction supervision with Recurrent History Compression (RHC) to follow condition updates while preserving visual continuity within a bounded token budget. Across proxy representations, Cross-Representation Flow Alignment (CRFA) connects proxy reconstruction with appearance and interaction variation through a shared high-fidelity reconstruction. WorldPrism, our interaction-centric dataset constructed from agent-built worlds, AAA gameplay, and open-source videos, supplies the corresponding renderings and chunk-level annotations for these learning tasks. Experiments on GWM-Bench and Solar-Bench show improved reconstruction and visual quality, while qualitative results demonstrate minute-long interactive rendering under changing prompts and subject references. Project page: https://rainzor.github.io/contextrenderer/

AI.brief_summary: 面向交互式游戏世界的自回归视频扩散渲染器：用分块级动态条件监督和循环历史压缩，在有界 token 预算内跟踪条件更新并保持视觉连续性，并通过跨表示对齐连接代理重建与外观、交互变化，另配套构建 WorldPrism 数据集。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「有界预算下的循环历史压缩」与分块条件更新可供核查 LVR 中长程 latent 状态的压缩、更新与细节保留，跨表示对齐也可能类比视觉证据在内部表示中的维持；但论文面向游戏视频渲染，不研究 VLM 推理，联系需较多核查。
